tasks.label: Generar imágenes optimizadas
args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path assets/img | Out-Null; Get-ChildItem assets/raw/*.jpg | ForEach-Object { magick $_.FullName -resize 400x -strip -quality 82 ('assets/img/' + $_.BaseName + '-mobile.jpg'); magick $_.FullName -resize 1000x -strip -quality 85 ('assets/img/' + $_.BaseName + '-desktop.jpg') }
